response.rationale: D6 (Intestinal tuberculosis) is strongly supported by the positive QuantiFERON-TB Gold, distal ileitis, and nontraversable distal ileal stricture. D8 (Ileocecal tuberculosis) is also strongly supported by similar findings, but D6 is a broader category that encompasses the findings more completely. D2 (Ileocecal Histoplasmosis) is contradicted by the positive QuantiFERON-TB Gold. D4 (Latent tuberculosis) is supported by the positive QuantiFERON-TB Gold, but the patient has active symptoms and findings (distal ileitis, stricture, ulcers) that suggest active disease, not just latent infection.
